vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes only. The packageRules below turn off every other Go update; Renovate applies this block after them, so a vulnerable module gets its own [SECURITY] PR.

packageRules.description: events-processor Go modules. The base preset disables every package outside ghcr.io/getlago; this rule turns them back on so Renovate looks them up. No matchDepTypes: Renovate skips indirect deps by default, and a vulnerable indirect dep (golang.org/x/net, klauspost/compress) then never moves. OSV reads the Go vulnerability database, which has advisories that Dependabot cannot match.
No routine Go updates: only the vulnerability alerts above open PRs.
